summary: Comprehensive testing completed for Kushnarenko & Partners law firm website. All major functionality working correctly including trilingual support, booking system, contact forms, and API integrations.

design_issues.issue: Language dropdown functionality needs verification - could not fully test language switching in automated tests

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section, services preview, and CTA buttons
Navigation works - all links (Home, About, Services, Team, Blog, Contact, Booking)
Services page displays all 6 legal services with detailed descriptions
Team page shows 4 team members with photos and professional information
Contact page has functional form and Google Maps embed
Blog page fetches and displays posts from API with proper trilingual content
Booking page multi-step form (personal info, service, date/time, confirmation) works end-to-end
Contact form submission works via API /api/contacts
Booking form submission works via API /api/consultations
Backend API /api/available-slots returns time slots correctly
Backend API /api/seed-blog seeds blog posts successfully
Footer displays correctly with links and contact information
All backend APIs (consultations, contacts, blog, available-slots) working correctly
Calendar integration for booking with date/time selection
Form validation and error handling working properly
Success notifications and confirmations displaying correctly
